bootstrap.caption: Set up a brand-new project from scratch, then take the tour.

verify.caption: Check your work (docs, local tests, CI) before you open a pull request.

build.caption: Work through the task board, one feature at a time.

ship.caption: Publish a release to GitHub. This pushes your code.

maintain.caption: Weekly health pass: security, dependencies, and a full review.

tour.caption: A 10-minute walkthrough. Home chrome is Settings-only.

init.caption: First-time setup: name, stack, and project files.

setup.caption: Turn on GitHub settings this template expects.

prune.caption: Keep only the stack you chose; drop unused examples.

gates.caption: Run the local checks that match CI (no GitHub wait).

coach.caption: Ask what to do next. Theme, About, and donate stay in Settings (Settings-only).

ideas.caption: See a short ranked list of possible next features (does not build them).

allideas.caption: Dump every in-scope idea so you can fill the task board.

plan.caption: Design one feature or decision before coding.

adr.caption: Write the next numbered architecture decision record.

feature.caption: Build one feature slice with tests, then run checks.

fix.caption: Repair failing checks after a build, in the feature you just touched.

cleanup.caption: Archive finished task-board rows so the list stays short.

scope.caption: Split work so more than one agent can help without colliding.

docs.caption: Check README health, tables, and file encoding.

ci.caption: Wait for GitHub Actions after a push (checks only, no new commit).

debug.caption: Investigate a bug with logs and evidence (not a full-repo audit).

update-deps.caption: Scan and apply safe local dependency bumps.

push.caption: Commit, push to GitHub, and cut a release. This publishes.

regress.caption: After a release: confirm SBOM, Pages, and the upgrade simulation.

codex-review.caption: Skip this. First-time path is Cline in Cursor (review every diff).

best-of-n.caption: Race a few local copies of a hard fix (never pushes).

emulator.caption: Run Android emulator tests if an SDK is installed; skip otherwise.

dependabot.caption: Handle leftover GitHub Dependabot alerts after local updates.

audit.caption: Full-repo review, then update the task board.

upgrade.caption: Compare this project to the parent template and plan updates. Does not overwrite your app until you pick items.

compact.caption: Save a checkpoint before you clear a long chat.

restore.caption: Reload the last saved checkpoint after a new chat.

resume.caption: After Cloud Agent work: fetch, sync open Dependabot/release PRs into BUILD_PLAN, list cursor/* PRs, name the next AGENT row.
